rationale: The agent executed a valid 2D metric-MDS analysis and reported both requested quantities. Its disagreement with the reference is justified by materially different, but reasonable, definitions: it uses unscaled expression values, sklearn's raw MDS stress_, centroid-to-centroid between-group distances, and an unweighted mean of per-group within distances; the reference standardizes data, calculates a normalized distance-reconstruction stress, and pools all cross-group and within-group sample-pair distances. Execution logs demonstrate the reported values were actually produced.

Its disagreement with the reference is justified by materially different, but reasonable, definitions: it uses unscaled expression values, sklearn's raw MDS stress_, centroid-to-centroid between-group distances, and an unweighted mean of per-group within distances; the reference standardizes data, calculates a normalized distance-reconstruction stress, and pools all cross-group and within-group sample-pair distances. audit_assessment.reference_method: Selects Gene_ columns, standardizes each gene with StandardScaler, fits 2D metric sklearn MDS (random_state=42), computes normalized reconstruction stress as sqrt(sum((pdist(scaled)-pdist(embedding))^2)/sum(pdist(scaled)^2)), and computes the ratio from pooled pairwise distances across all samples from distinct groups divided by pooled within-group sample-pair distances.
audit_assessment.agent_method: Loads the CSV with Sample_ID as index, separates Group from the 50 expression columns, fits 2D metric sklearn MDS on unscaled features with random_state=42, reports sklearn MDS stress_, calculates between-group distance as the mean pairwise distance among group centroids, calculates within-group distance as the mean of each group's mean pairwise sample distance, and reports their ratio.
